'''Hedron''' is a [[Common enemy]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Enemy description|The "Diaphaistagran" (archive ID: ARM315) is a fluid-based pattern with energy projecting capabilities. Its shape is that of a complex yet symmetrical geometry. Its attacks can also sap heat from any surface they come in contact with.}}

==Overview==
As one of the basic ranged [[Aggeloi]], Hedrons are slightly more threatening than [[Sting]]s, but it doesn't make them more of the threat; Their only attack is a shot which deals Cryo damage and {{G|Cryo Infliction}} in an area.
